test_would_warn_no_config: test the _would_warn function returns True when no allowlist environment variables are set
test_would_warn_signal_group: test _would_warn returns False when SIGNAL_GROUP_ALLOWED_USERS environment variable is set
test_would_warn_telegram_allow_all: test _would_warn returns False when TELEGRAM_ALLOW_ALL_USERS is set to true
test_would_warn_gateway_allow_all: test _would_warn returns False when GATEWAY_ALLOW_ALL_USERS is set to yes
test_testallowliststartupcheck_class: test the TestAllowlistStartupCheck class and its startup allowlist warning check methods
